exposure: induction of labor by misoprostol vaginal inserts
cohort: 446 women over 37 weeks of gestation admitted for labor induction by misoprostol vaginal inserts between May 2016 and May 2017
finding: Tachysystole during labor induction with misoprostol vaginal inserts was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Tachysystole during labor induction with misoprostol vaginal inserts was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
